summary.note: PV follows website default integer panel-area rounding, capped at 80%, factor 0.144; low-potential category excluded. Shared/larger roof polygons are allocated by intersection area / solar polygon area, assuming uniform PV potential. Allocated values are estimates, not website building-specific readings.
summary.panel_coverage_definition: Potential panel area under the map default calculator, not installed PV. Roof denominator is takyta_a, the website Total Takyta. Same allocation weights as annual PV extraction. Flat-roof tilted-row spacing adjustment not applied.
